questions.title: How many times may a broken claim be retried?
questions.why: A second stale run on the same issue usually means the issue is the problem.

questions.title: Where does the claim comment go?

options.title: On the PR once one exists

questions.why: Moving it later adds a second place to look.

settled.title: What stale means
settled.answer: No activity from the claiming run, judged by pushes and CI.
